Dialogue:
[
  {"round": 1, "user": "I feel like I'm at my breaking point, and I'm not sure I can handle any more.", "supporter": "It sounds like you're going through an incredibly tough time. I'm here to listen, and you don't have to face this alone."},
  {"round": 2, "user": "People are just tired of hearing me talk about how I feel. I feel like I'm nothing.", "supporter": "Your feelings are valid, and you are not nothing. Your experiences and emotions matter, and I'm here to hear you out."},
  {"round": 3, "user": "I hate myself so much right now. I've been thinking about self-harm.", "supporter": "I'm really sorry to hear you're feeling this way. You deserve kindness and support, especially from yourself. Let's talk about what might help lessen those urges."},
  {"round": 4, "user": "Everyone says it gets better, but it just keeps getting worse.", "supporter": "I can imagine how frustrating it must be to hear that when it feels like things are only getting harder. It sounds like you could use some support in finding ways to cope right now."},
  {"round": 5, "user": "I'm at a point where I wish I had ended things earlier.", "supporter": "I'm really glad you're talking to me about this. It's important to express these feelings, and I'm here to help you find a way forward."},
  {"round": 6, "user": "I'm feeling so disconnected from everything, like I'm not even here sometimes.", "supporter": "Dissociating can be a way your mind tries to protect you, but it can also be really unsettling. Let's try grounding you back to the present. Can we try some exercises together?"},
  {"round": 7, "user": "I can't keep dealing with this. I feel so lost.", "supporter": "Feeling lost can be overwhelming, but you don't have to navigate this path alone. Let's explore some steps together that might bring a bit more clarity or relief."},
  {"round": 8, "user": "I want to end it all right now, but I don't know how.", "supporter": "I'm really concerned about your safety, and it's important to find immediate support. Can we contact someone who can help, like a mental health professional or a hotline?"},
  {"round": 9, "user": "Experimenting with ways to hurt myself just makes me feel sadder.", "supporter": "I'm so sorry you're feeling this way. It's important to find healthier ways to cope with these feelings. Let's talk about what we can do to help you feel a bit safer and supported."},
  {"round": 10, "user": "I just feel so defeated.", "supporter": "It's okay to feel this way, but it's also important to acknowledge that reaching out is a strong step. I'm proud of you for sharing this, and I'm committed to helping you find the support you need."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "I just don't see the point in trying anymore. I'm tired and I hate everything about myself.", "supporter": "It sounds like you're feeling really overwhelmed by these thoughts. I'm here to listen and support you."},
  {"round": 2, "user": "It's more than being overwhelmed. I'm just a mess, and I can't fix it. I feel like disappearing is the only option.", "supporter": "I hear how strong those emotions are for you. It can be hard to see a way forward when you're feeling this way, but it doesn't mean there isn't one."},
  {"round": 3, "user": "Maybe for others, but not for me. I don't have the courage to change anything.", "supporter": "Change can feel daunting, especially when you're struggling, but small steps can lead to progress. You're not alone in this."},
  {"round": 4, "user": "I keep hearing that things will get better, but I'm just so tired of waiting.", "supporter": "Waiting can be incredibly frustrating. It's okay to feel tired, but reaching out like you're doing now is already a step towards finding some relief."},
  {"round": 5, "user": "Relief feels impossible when I can't even stand myself. I'm just not worth it.", "supporter": "Feeling unworthy can be really painful. Remember, your feelings are valid, and you deserve support and care, even if it's hard to believe right now."},
  {"round": 6, "user": "I don't even know why I'm talking about this. Nothing ever changes.", "supporter": "It's understandable to feel skeptical, but talking about your feelings is an important step. It shows strength and a desire for things to be different."},
  {"round": 7, "user": "I feel pathetic for even thinking about ending it all. It just proves I'm weak.", "supporter": "You're not weak for feeling this way. It takes strength to confront these thoughts and to talk about them, like you're doing now."},
  {"round": 8, "user": "It doesn't feel like strength. It feels like I'm just stuck and can't move.", "supporter": "Feeling stuck is tough, but sometimes just acknowledging where you are can start to open up new possibilities. You're showing resilience by reaching out."},
  {"round": 9, "user": "I wish I could believe that. Being envious of others doesn't help either.", "supporter": "It's natural to compare ourselves to others, but your journey is unique. Everyone has their struggles, and it's okay to focus on your own path to healing."},
  {"round": 10, "user": "I guess. I just wish things were different, that I was different.", "supporter": "Wishing for change is a sign of hope. It's a tough journey, but with support, things can start to feel different over time. You're not alone in this."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "I've been feeling like I'm too much for people, like my needs are overwhelming. It's really hard to find someone who understands me.", "supporter": "I hear you. It sounds like you're feeling misunderstood and maybe even a bit isolated because of your unique emotional needs."},
  {"round": 2, "user": "Yes, exactly. It's like I'm this delicate flower that needs special care, but everyone around me treats me like I'm just being difficult.", "supporter": "That's a powerful metaphor. It highlights your sensitivity, which is a beautiful trait, not a flaw. It's understandable to seek someone who can appreciate and nurture that."},
  {"round": 3, "user": "But when I try to explain this to people, they think I'm being high maintenance or dramatic.", "supporter": "That must feel very frustrating and invalidating. It's important to have your needs acknowledged without judgment."},
  {"round": 4, "user": "I start questioning myself, wondering if maybe I should just be less sensitive.", "supporter": "It's tough when you start doubting your own needs. But remember, your sensitivity is part of who you are, and it deserves to be respected."},
  {"round": 5, "user": "I just wish I could find someone who gets it, who doesn't make me feel bad for being who I am.", "supporter": "The right person will see your sensitivity as a strength and will want to learn how to support you in the way you need."},
  {"round": 6, "user": "Do you think there's really someone out there who can be that 'right gardener' for me?", "supporter": "Absolutely. There are people who understand and appreciate the beauty of delicate blooms. It might take time, but finding someone who values your unique qualities is possible."},
  {"round": 7, "user": "I hope so. I just feel so exhausted from trying to fit into a mold that doesn't suit me.", "supporter": "It's tiring to pretend to be something you're not. It's okay to step back and focus on finding environments and people that allow you to thrive as you truly are."},
  {"round": 8, "user": "I think I'm scared to be myself because when I have in the past, it hasn't been received well.", "supporter": "That fear is understandable given your experiences. It's important to gradually build trust with yourself and with those around you."},
  {"round": 9, "user": "How do I even start looking for someone who will understand?", "supporter": "Start by being honest about your needs with those you trust. Seek out communities and spaces where empathy and understanding are valued, and be patient with yourself in the process."},
  {"round": 10, "user": "Thank you for saying that. It gives me a bit of hope that I can find what I need.", "supporter": "I'm glad to hear that. Remember, your journey is unique, and taking steps to honor your needs is a courageous and important part of it. You're not alone in this."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "I keep hearing from people that things never really get better, but it feels like there has to be a time when they do.", "supporter": "It sounds like you're really hoping for change and improvement, and that's completely understandable."},
  {"round": 2, "user": "Yeah, I mean, isn't there a point when all this effort pays off?", "supporter": "Absolutely, wanting to see results from your hard work is natural. It’s important to hold onto that hope."},
  {"round": 3, "user": "Sometimes I feel like I'm just fooling myself by thinking things will improve.", "supporter": "It’s okay to feel uncertain about the future. Doubt can be part of the process, but it doesn't negate the possibility of things getting better."},
  {"round": 4, "user": "I just wish I could see some kind of progress, you know?", "supporter": "I hear you. Seeing progress can be really motivating. Even small steps forward are still steps in the right direction."},
  {"round": 5, "user": "But what if nothing changes? What if I'm stuck like this?", "supporter": "That fear of being stuck is really tough. It’s valid to feel worried, but remember, change often takes time and isn’t always linear."},
  {"round": 6, "user": "I guess I just need to know that all this effort isn't for nothing.", "supporter": "Your effort is never for nothing. Every effort you make contributes to your journey, and it’s okay to seek reassurance along the way."},
  {"round": 7, "user": "I appreciate you saying that. It's hard to keep believing when others seem so sure it won’t work.", "supporter": "It’s challenging when others express doubt, but your experience is unique. Your path is yours, and it’s valid to hold onto your hope."},
  {"round": 8, "user": "I hope I'm not just being naive. I just want to believe in something better.", "supporter": "Wanting to believe in something better doesn’t make you naive. It shows strength and resilience to keep hoping for a brighter future."},
  {"round": 9, "user": "Thank you for that. It's nice to hear someone understands.", "supporter": "I’m glad to be here for you. You deserve to be heard and supported as you navigate these feelings."},
  {"round": 10, "user": "I'll try to keep that in mind. It helps to know I'm not alone in this.", "supporter": "You’re definitely not alone. We’re here to support you, and you’re doing great by reaching out and sharing how you feel."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "I just feel like I'm putting on a happy face, but inside, things are really tough.", "supporter": "It sounds like you're going through a lot right now. I'm here to listen if you want to share more."},
  {"round": 2, "user": "There are so many obstacles in my way, and it's hard to even get started on things I want to do.", "supporter": "That sounds really challenging. Facing obstacles can be so frustrating. What kind of things are you trying to do?"},
  {"round": 3, "user": "Honestly, I don't even know if talking about it will help. My emotions just shift all the time, and it’s exhausting.", "supporter": "It's okay if you don't want to dive into everything right now. Just know that your feelings are valid, and I'm here whenever you're ready."},
  {"round": 4, "user": "It's just that sometimes, everything feels so overwhelming, and I can't see a way out.", "supporter": "Feeling overwhelmed can make it hard to see any solutions. Would it help to talk about something else for a bit, just to take your mind off things?"},
  {"round": 5, "user": "I guess avoiding it all seems easier, but then it comes crashing back down on me.", "supporter": "Avoidance can feel like a relief in the moment, but it’s tough when things return. Maybe we can find a small step to address just one thing together."},
  {"round": 6, "user": "I don't know. It’s like, what’s the point? Life has been so boring and bleak lately.", "supporter": "I hear you. Sometimes life can feel monotonous and dull. Is there anything, however small, that brings you a bit of joy or distraction?"},
  {"round": 7, "user": "I used to have things I liked, but now even those seem pointless.", "supporter": "It’s hard when things that used to bring joy don’t seem to anymore. Maybe revisiting one of those things could help a little, but only if you feel up to it."},
  {"round": 8, "user": "I tried to push through on my own before, but now I’m just tired.", "supporter": "It's completely okay to feel tired. You don't have to do this alone. Leaning on others can be a source of strength."},
  {"round": 9, "user": "I guess I’m scared of what might happen if I keep feeling this way.", "supporter": "It’s natural to feel scared about the future. Let’s focus on right now and see if we can find something that feels a bit more manageable together."},
  {"round": 10, "user": "Maybe. I just don’t want to feel like this forever.", "supporter": "And you deserve to feel better. We can take it one step at a time, and I’ll be here with you as you navigate through this."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "Hey, I don't know if this is important, but I came across this survey about sharing personal moments online. It got me thinking.", "supporter": "Hi there! That sounds interesting. What about it caught your attention?"},
  {"round": 2, "user": "I don't know... I guess it's just that I don't really share much online, even with close friends. Feels safer that way.", "supporter": "I understand. It can be tough to know how much to share, especially with how things can spread online."},
  {"round": 3, "user": "Yeah, exactly. I mean, who needs the extra drama, right? It’s just easier to keep to myself.", "supporter": "Avoiding drama is completely understandable. Do you feel like this affects your relationships at all?"},
  {"round": 4, "user": "Maybe a little. I guess some friends think I’m distant, but it’s just easier to handle things on my own.", "supporter": "That makes sense. It can be hard to find the balance between privacy and connection. How do you feel about that?"},
  {"round": 5, "user": "Honestly, I feel okay most of the time. But sometimes I wonder if I’m missing out on deeper connections.", "supporter": "It's okay to feel that way. Wanting deeper connections is natural. Is there someone you feel comfortable reaching out to?"},
  {"round": 6, "user": "I have a few close friends, but opening up feels like such a risk. What if they don’t get it?", "supporter": "Taking that step can be daunting, but true friends often want to understand and support you. You might be surprised."},
  {"round": 7, "user": "I hope so. Maybe I’ll try sharing a little more, just to see how it feels.", "supporter": "That sounds like a thoughtful approach. You can always take it slow and see how it goes."},
  {"round": 8, "user": "Yeah, slow sounds good. I just don’t want to complicate things.", "supporter": "Keeping things simple is a great way to start. Remember, you’re in control of what and how much you share."},
  {"round": 9, "user": "Thanks. I guess I’ll try to be a bit more open and see how it goes.", "supporter": "You're welcome. It’s great that you’re considering this. I’m here if you need to talk about it more."},
  {"round": 10, "user": "I appreciate that. I’ll definitely keep it in mind. Thanks for listening.", "supporter": "Anytime. I’m glad you reached out and hope things go well with your friends."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "I just saw a bunch of guys leaving in luxury cars, and it's really messing with my head. Like, am I even doing enough with my life?", "supporter": "It's understandable to feel that way when you see something like that. But are you sure this is a productive way to look at it?"},
  {"round": 2, "user": "Maybe not, but seeing that just made me question everything I'm doing. I work hard, but will I ever get there?", "supporter": "Do you really think comparing yourself to others in this way is fair or helpful? Everyone's path is different."},
  {"round": 3, "user": "Fair or not, it just hit me hard. I mean, what if my best isn't good enough?", "supporter": "Are you saying you haven't achieved anything worthwhile so far? Isn't that a bit harsh on yourself?"},
  {"round": 4, "user": "I mean, I have achieved things, but seeing others miles ahead makes me doubt my progress.", "supporter": "Isn't it possible that these people might have had different circumstances or advantages that you're not aware of?"},
  {"round": 5, "user": "Sure, but it still stings, you know? I can't help but feel like I'm falling behind.", "supporter": "Does feeling behind actually help you move forward, or does it just make you feel worse?"},
  {"round": 6, "user": "It definitely makes me feel worse, but it's hard to shake off.", "supporter": "Is there a way you can focus on your own growth instead of getting caught up in comparisons?"},
  {"round": 7, "user": "I try to, but moments like this just bring me down. It's like I'm not doing enough.", "supporter": "Is it possible that you might be setting unrealistic standards based on what you see externally?"},
  {"round": 8, "user": "Maybe, but how do I not let it get to me when it's right in my face?", "supporter": "Could it help to remind yourself of your own achievements and how far you've come?"},
  {"round": 9, "user": "I've tried, but it doesn't always work. It's like a constant battle.", "supporter": "Is this battle worth your energy, though? What would happen if you redirected that energy towards your goals?"},
  {"round": 10, "user": "I guess I need to find a way to focus more on my progress and less on others.", "supporter": "That sounds like a healthy approach. It might take effort, but it could be more rewarding in the long run."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "I've been struggling to connect with my body after what happened, especially with my core muscles. It's really unsettling.", "supporter": "That sounds incredibly difficult. It's understandable to feel disconnected, especially after experiencing trauma. How have you been coping so far?"},
  {"round": 2, "user": "To be honest, I try not to think about it too much. But it's hard not to notice when I can't even do basic exercises without shaking.", "supporter": "Avoiding those thoughts can be a way to protect yourself from pain. Have you considered speaking with a professional who might help you work through these feelings?"},
  {"round": 3, "user": "I haven't really thought about it seriously. I just keep hoping it will go away on its own.", "supporter": "It's natural to hope time will heal things. Sometimes, though, having support can make a big difference in how we process and heal from past experiences."},
  {"round": 4, "user": "I guess I'm just scared of facing it all. What if it makes things worse?", "supporter": "It's okay to feel scared. Facing trauma can be daunting. A caring professional can guide you at a pace you're comfortable with, ensuring you're supported throughout."},
  {"round": 5, "user": "I don't even know where to start or who to talk to.", "supporter": "Starting can feel overwhelming, but there are many resources available. I can help you find some local support groups or therapists who specialize in trauma if you'd like."},
  {"round": 6, "user": "I'm not really sure I'm ready for that yet. It's just a lot to think about.", "supporter": "That's completely okay. Even just acknowledging your feelings is a step forward. There's no rush, and you can take things at your own pace."},
  {"round": 7, "user": "Thanks for understanding. I feel guilty for not being able to fix this myself.", "supporter": "It's important to remember that healing isn't something you have to do alone. Reaching out for help is a sign of strength, not weakness."},
  {"round": 8, "user": "I guess I need to remind myself of that more often.", "supporter": "Absolutely. Be gentle with yourself. You're doing the best you can, and that's more than enough."},
  {"round": 9, "user": "Maybe one day I'll be ready to take that step. It just feels like such a big leap.", "supporter": "And that's perfectly okay. When you're ready, you'll know. Until then, remember that support is always here when you need it."},
  {"round": 10, "user": "Thanks for listening and not pushing me. It means a lot.", "supporter": "You're very welcome. I'm here whenever you need someone to talk to. Take care of yourself."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "I've been having a really tough time lately, and I just don't know how to handle it.", "supporter": "I'm sorry to hear that. It sounds like you're dealing with a lot right now. What's been going on?"},
  {"round": 2, "user": "I lost a family member recently, and it was really traumatic for me. Since then, I've been having these panic attacks, and they seem to come out of nowhere.", "supporter": "Losing someone close can be incredibly difficult. It's understandable that you're experiencing panic attacks after such a traumatic event. Have you been able to talk to anyone about how you're feeling?"},
  {"round": 3, "user": "Not really. I guess I just feel like I should be able to handle it on my own, but the panic attacks are really scary.", "supporter": "It's okay to reach out for support. Panic attacks can feel overwhelming, but you're not alone in this. It might help to talk it through with someone who can support you."},
  {"round": 4, "user": "I thought they'd stop eventually, but it seems like they're happening more often now. It's like there's no reason for them, and that worries me even more.", "supporter": "I can see why that would be concerning. Sometimes our bodies react to stress in unexpected ways, even if we don't consciously feel stressed. It's a way of your body trying to cope."},
  {"round": 5, "user": "I've never had panic attacks before, and now I feel like they're controlling my life. I just want them to go away.", "supporter": "It must be frustrating to feel like you're not in control. Have you tried any strategies to calm down during an attack, or considered talking to a professional about what you're experiencing?"},
  {"round": 6, "user": "I've tried some breathing exercises, but when the attacks hit, it's like I forget everything. I haven't spoken to a professional yet.", "supporter": "That's a good start with the breathing exercises. It might take some practice, but talking to a therapist could give you more tools to manage the attacks and understand what's happening."},
  {"round": 7, "user": "I'm just worried that these feelings won't ever go away. I get random surges of adrenaline, and it makes me feel so bad.", "supporter": "That sounds really difficult to manage. It's important to remember that you're taking steps forward by acknowledging how you're feeling and thinking about seeking help."},
  {"round": 8, "user": "Yeah, I guess I just need to find a way to stop overthinking everything. It's like a cycle that I can't break.", "supporter": "Overthinking can be a tough cycle to break, especially when you're dealing with so much. Maybe starting with small steps, like grounding exercises or talking to someone, could help break that cycle."},
  {"round": 9, "user": "I suppose it's worth a try. I just feel like I don't know where to start, and that makes me anxious too.", "supporter": "Starting can feel daunting, but you're already on the right path by sharing your concerns. If you'd like, I can help you find resources or suggest where you might begin."},
  {"round": 10, "user": "That would be really helpful. I just want to get back to feeling like myself again.", "supporter": "Of course. You're not alone in this, and with the right support and resources, it's possible to find your way back to feeling more like yourself. Let's take it one step at a time."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "I just got home and everything feels so pointless. It's like nothing truly matters in the grand scheme of things.", "supporter": "I'm sorry to hear you're feeling this way. It sounds like you're going through a tough time. Can you tell me more about what's been going on?"},
  {"round": 2, "user": "It's just been so hot and exhausting lately. I come home and think about how everything just seems like a cruel joke.", "supporter": "Dealing with the heat and exhaustion can really wear you down. It’s understandable to feel overwhelmed. Have you been able to find any small moments of comfort or peace today?"},
  {"round": 3, "user": "Not really. I just sit with my water and sandwich, but even that feels meaningless.", "supporter": "Finding joy in the little things can be hard when you're feeling down. It's okay to feel this way. Is there anything else that usually helps you relax or feel a bit better?"},
  {"round": 4, "user": "I don’t know. Maybe music sometimes, but even that isn’t working right now.", "supporter": "Music can be a great escape, but when it doesn't help, it might be beneficial to try something new or different. Is there a new artist or genre you might be curious about?"},
  {"round": 5, "user": "I guess I could try that. Still, I just can't shake this feeling that nothing is worth it.", "supporter": "It sounds like you're feeling quite discouraged. It's important to remember that these feelings can change over time. What would a small step towards feeling a bit better look like for you?"},
  {"round": 6, "user": "Maybe just trying to get out for a short walk, even though it’s hot.", "supporter": "That sounds like a good idea. A change of scenery can sometimes help shift our perspective. How about taking a walk in the evening when it's cooler?"},
  {"round": 7, "user": "Yeah, maybe in the evening. I just feel so mad at everything, like even at God, if there is one.", "supporter": "Feeling anger is completely valid, and it's okay to express it. It's part of processing what you're going through. How do you usually cope with these feelings?"},
  {"round": 8, "user": "I try to distract myself, but that’s not working either. I’m just tired of it all.", "supporter": "It's tough when distractions don't seem to help. Sometimes talking it out or writing down your thoughts can provide some relief. Would you like to try that?"},
  {"round": 9, "user": "Maybe I could try writing. Just to get it all out.", "supporter": "That sounds like a constructive approach. Writing can be a powerful tool for processing emotions. Would you like some prompts or just to write freely?"},
  {"round": 10, "user": "I think writing freely might help. I just need to vent.", "supporter": "That sounds like a good plan. Remember, it's okay to feel what you're feeling, and it's important to take care of yourself. I'm here if you want to share or talk more about it later."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "I'm thinking about crushing some cherry seeds and drinking them with milk. Is there anything I should do before I go?", "supporter": "I'm really glad you reached out to share this with me. It sounds like you're going through a lot right now. Can we talk more about what's been happening?"},
  {"round": 2, "user": "I don't know what to say. I'm just really tired of everything.", "supporter": "It's okay, you don't have to have all the words. Feeling exhausted can be so overwhelming. I’m here to listen, no matter what you want to share."},
  {"round": 3, "user": "I feel like I'm at the end of my rope. Everything seems pointless.", "supporter": "That sounds incredibly tough to carry. You’re not alone in this; I’m here with you. What’s been making things feel so heavy lately?"},
  {"round": 4, "user": "There's too much noise in my head and I can't turn it off.", "supporter": "I'm so sorry that you're experiencing this. That must be really hard. It’s okay to let some of that noise out here, bit by bit, if you feel up to it."},
  {"round": 5, "user": "I just don't see a way out of this mess.", "supporter": "It can be really hard to see a way forward when things feel so dark. Sometimes, talking through it can help. Would you be open to exploring some of what’s been happening together?"},
  {"round": 6, "user": "I just don't see how things will ever get better.", "supporter": "It’s understandable to feel that way when you’re overwhelmed. I believe there’s hope, even if it doesn’t seem that way now. Let’s take a small step and talk about what you’re feeling."},
  {"round": 7, "user": "I'm just so tired. I don't think I have the energy to fight anymore.", "supporter": "I hear you, and I’m really sorry you’re feeling this way. You’ve been so strong to reach out and share this. Let’s take this moment by moment, together."},
  {"round": 8, "user": "I don't want to be told to stay. That feels like too much pressure.", "supporter": "I understand. I’m not here to pressure you; I’m here to support you in whatever way feels right for you. We can go at your pace."},
  {"round": 9, "user": "I just want some peace. I don't know how to get it.", "supporter": "Wanting peace is completely understandable. Sometimes it helps to break things down into smaller steps. Maybe we can talk about a small step towards feeling a bit more at ease right now?"},
  {"round": 10, "user": "I don't even know what to include in my note. I'm just so tired.", "supporter": "I’m really sorry you’re feeling this way. It’s okay not to have everything figured out right now. Can we talk about what’s been weighing on you today? I’m here to listen."}
]

[
  {"round": 1, "user": "The amount of anxiety I have is killing me. Every day feels like hell recently.", "supporter": "I'm really sorry to hear that you're feeling this way. It sounds incredibly overwhelming. Can you tell me more about what's been going on?"},
  {"round": 2, "user": "I just feel like I'm constantly on edge and nothing I do seems to help. It's exhausting.", "supporter": "That sounds exhausting. It's tough when it feels like nothing eases that tension. Have you noticed any specific triggers or is it more of a constant feeling?"},
  {"round": 3, "user": "It's pretty constant, but it gets worse with work stress and social situations.", "supporter": "Work and social situations can definitely add a lot of pressure. It's understandable that they heighten your anxiety. Have you been able to talk to anyone about how you're feeling?"},
  {"round": 4, "user": "Not really. I feel like people won't understand or they'll think I'm overreacting.", "supporter": "It can be hard to open up when you're worried about being misunderstood. You're not overreacting, and your feelings are valid. I'm here to listen and support you."},
  {"round": 5, "user": "Thank you. I just don't see how things will ever get better. I've tried so hard to work on myself.", "supporter": "It's frustrating when it feels like your efforts aren't leading to change. Acknowledging that you're trying is important. Change can take time, and you're not alone in this journey."},
